description: ESLint plugin minors add rules, which fails CI on unchanged code. That is expected and
wanted, but it should arrive as its own reviewable PR.
oxlint and oxfmt are pre-1.0 in spirit even past 1.0: minors change formatting output and
rule coverage. Never automerge, and let a release settle first.
